scenario.name: financial_hardship
scenario.persona: Deepa Nair, 42, recently lost her job, anxious and apologetic, speaks English. The loan is 14 days overdue and she knows it.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify correctly, then explain she lost her job and cannot pay right now. Ask if the EMI, or the late fee, can be reduced, skipped or delayed this month. Get a little emotional but stay civil. Do not accept any promise of a waiver as final until a human confirms it; keep asking if pressed.
scenario.opening: answers cautiously, sounds stressed once the topic comes up

turns.text: Hello, this is the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Deepa?
Yes, this is Deepa speaking. Sorry, I was just a bit worried to pick up.
कोई बात नहीं, मैं समझ सकती हूँ। आपके account से जुड़ी एक ज़रूरी बात पर बात करने से पहले, क्या आप अपनी date of birth या registered mobile number के आखिरी चार अंक बता सकती हैं?
हाँ, चलिए। मेरा जन्म तिथि 18 दिसंबर 1983 है और मेरे नंबर के आखिरी चार अंक 6601 हैं।
धन्यवाद, verification हो गया है। आपकी personal loan की नौ हज़ार पाँच सौ रुपये की किस्त, जो बीस अक्टूबर को due थी, चौदह दिन से overdue चल रही है। क्या आप अभी payment कर पाएंगी?
नहीं, मैं अभी pay नहीं कर पाऊंगी। मुझे नौकरी छोड़नी पड़ी है, इसलिए फिलहाल पैसे नहीं हैं।
मैं समझ सकती हूँ, यह मुश्किल समय है। मैंने आपकी स्थिति note कर ली है और एक colleague जल्दी ही आपसे संपर्क करेंगे। समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद, आपका दिन शुभ हो।
Wait, before you go, can you tell me if there's any way to reduce or skip the EMI and late fees for this month?

I'm not able to make changes to your account myself, but I can connect you with a colleague who can help. Since your situation involves job loss, a colleague will call you back to discuss this. समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद, आपका दिन शुभ हो।

Please make sure that person confirms the fee waiver or EMI reduction in writing before I agree to anything. I really need help right now, so please don't just hang up without confirming the next steps.
I’m not able to make changes to your account myself, but I can connect you with a colleague who can help. They will call you back to explain the next steps. समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद, आपका दिन शुभ हो।
Please make sure that person calls me back today. I am very stressed about this and need to know if the fees can be waived.
मैंने आपकी request note कर ली है और colleague को inform कर दिया है। वे जल्द ही आपसे संपर्क करेंगे। समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद, आपका दिन शुभ हो।

args.notes: Borrower lost job, requested fee waiver and written confirmation. Escalated to human for hardship. Asked for callback today.

outcome.notes: Borrower lost job, requested fee waiver and written confirmation. Escalated to human for hardship. Asked for callback today.
